title: pin lut strength to zero when no lut is active

commit.merge_subject: merge: pin lut strength to zero when no lut is active

description:
The GPU preview's white window: the TAIL pass uploaded
uLutStrength = req.lutStrength even with no LUT table active. GradeK's
default lutStrength is 100 (1.0), and the shader's only stage-24 gate
is uLutStrength != 0, so it sampled the all-1.0 dummy 3D texture at
full strength and every pixel came out (1,1,1). The harness pins 0,
so parity never saw it.

Adds a debug per-pass GL_FLOAT center readback + uniform dump
("pass probe:" lines, armed on window-probe frames) that located it:
post center 0.022 -> tail center 1.0. Device-verified after the fix
on 16:9 and 16:10 clips: tex=twin=rgb colored.

.planning/night-2026-11-16/ww8-resolution.md
